S4 E24 — The One With Ross's Wedding Part 2Phoebe tries to get in touch with someone to warn them that Rachel's on the way to the wedding. Meanwhile, Ross and Emily's parents meet at the wedding rehearsal dinner.

S5 E1 — The One After Ross Says RachelIn the aftermath of his Freudian slip, Ross tries to rescue his marriage with Emily. Meanwhile, Chandler and Monica try and find a moment alone in order to continue their affair while overseas.

S9 E24 — Moons Over SeattleNiles eventually persuades the reluctant Mr Moon to come to Seattle and talk with his wife. He is prepared to leave immediately after Mrs Moon rejects him, but Niles convinces him to stay for a while.
S10 E1 — The Ring CycleAfter Daphne and Niles elope in Reno, they are forced to go through several fake ceremonies in order not to upset friends and family who wanted to be at the wedding.

S16 E59 — Episode 59Develop your prowess in the kitchen with one of Australia’s most loved cooks, Justine Schofield. Along with an array of amazing guests Justine inspires cooks of all skill levels to be more ambitious and creative in their kitchens.

S4 E18 — Talking PointsWhen a patient loses the ability to speak, John gets him a machine that talks for him, but the man uses it to lash out at people; Bob turns into an environmentalist to impress a girl.

S10 E4 — Kissing CousinRoz's younger cousin comes to visit and makes her feel old. Meanwhile, Frasier learns that Kenny hasn't unpacked his boxes in his office, because he sees every job as temporary.

S10 E5 — Tales From The CryptFrasier is infuriated when Bulldog successfully pulls several practical jokes on him. He vows to get revenge, and plots an elaborate prank that he takes way too seriously.

S5 E10 — The One With The Inappropriate SisterPhoebe collects money for the Salvation Army during the holidays. A bored Ross creates havoc in Joey and Chandler's lives. Rachel is disturbed by her date's inappropriate relationship with his sister.

S5 E11 — The One With All The ResolutionsThe friends all make New Year's resolutions, but it looks like Rachel's resolution to stop gossiping is going to be the hardest to keep when she finds out about Chandler and Monica's dating.

S5 E12 — The One With Chandler's Work LaughAn upset Ross dates Janice after discovering that Emily is getting remarried. Monica hates the fake laugh that Chandler uses in response to his boss' terrible jokes.

S5 E13 — The One With Joey's BagPhoebe meets her father at her grandmother's funeral. Chandler discovers that Monica gives bad massages. Rachel dresses Joey for an audition, complete with a man's shoulder bag.
S2 E11 — Last Chance To See Those TattoosCharlie sets out to find who started a derogatory website about him. Alan overhears something he shouldn't on Jake's webcam.
S2 E12 — A Lungful Of AlanAn old classmate is in town while Charlie and Alan spar over whom she likes more.
S2 E13 — Zejdz Zmoich Wlosow (Get Off My Hair)Tensions rise after an earthquake displaces Judith to Charlie's house.

p.t: Why The Heck Did I Buy This House
p.d: A couple fell in love with the exterior of their new home, but unfortunately, that love stopped at the front door. With a dysfunction that's too much to bear, Kim and her team face the challenge of turning their confused home into a relaxing rancher.
Jasmine struggles to find a new studio as she helps a newly divorced mom.

A Romanian couple looks to trade their hectic lifestyle in Bucharest for a slower pace in Valencia, Spain; he's opening a business and wants to find a place near the city centre, but she prefers something that's more on the outskirts of town.
A couple is in their tiny apartment with three growing boys in Portage, Indiana is in search of a new home.

After a big promotion, a couple looks to relocate from Colorado and buy a home in Washington, DC. Despite the extra cash they'll be making, one is determined to keep a tight grip on the purse strings, but the other is ready.

Keith and Evan score when they purchase a dilapidated Victorian home in the Corktown neighbourhood of Detroit. From cracking walls and ceilings to an entirely missing staircase, they soon realise this treasure comes with more than a few troubles.

Jenn re-envisions a couple's 1960s home which suited their family when they had one kid, but now they have three and the space is closing in on them. Jenn takes the house from cramped and cluttered to open and airy with a modern design.

A Boston native knew she was lucky when she won a million, but now she scored a whopping $25 million on a scratcher! She's ready to buy each of her adult children a dream home, and she's calling on David to help find their first family hub in Atlanta!

Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them and accidentally shrinks them all.

The Ninjas, Lloyd, Sensei Wu and Misako journey to the Dark Island to find a 'Temple of Light' that can restore the Ninjas' elemental powers but are attacked by Starteeth that start eating through their ship.
A church carnival leads Missy to try out for the baseball team. Meanwhile, Meemaw struggles after her breakup with Dr. Sturgis.
Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.
Sheldon starts the first internet flame war, and Missy stands up to the boys on her baseball team. Meanwhile, Meemaw is unhappy when George spends time with her new boyfriend.
The zoo's penguin colony gets annual exams, and the staff holds its collective breath as a rare pangolin pregnancy unfolds at the Columbus Zoo.
Irish dancer Eva is saving for a new competition dress, but a big brunch bill and regular trips to the school canteen threaten to blow her budget. Can she change her ways before it's too late?
Manatees, leopards, penguins and whale sharks are all beloved by their caregivers, who explain why they're really the cutest creatures on earth.

Merlin and Arthur have been on many quests in search of the missing Lady Morgana. The despondent Prince is all but ready to give up. But as they recover from their latest skirmish, a bruised figure emerges from the mist.

Jessica and Louis enjoy a Valentine's Day evening while the boys are being babysat, but Emery gets a shock when he walks in on his parents' special alone time. Eddie strives to take Alison to the Janet Jackson concert.
Without Dr. Sturgis's university class, Sheldon must find a new way to stay academically challenged. Also, Mary helps Pastor Jeff avoid temptation with his girlfriend.
Ash and friends meet an eccentric Trainer who challenges May to her very first Pokemon battle!
Dr Xand goes underwater to show how your blood clots, and Dr Ronx finds out how echolocation - an amazing navigation technique used by bats to fly in the dark - is helping visually impaired patients.
The Bears and their new friend, Squatter Otter, take up residence in a mysterious house made of meat.
The Bears book a night at a hotel for dogs.
When Hannah shows off a homemade kite, her stunts cause a barbequing accident, sparking multiple fires!
Amma and Appa are going out so Nana is babysitting - it's Nana Night! But will the boys get to sleep before they turn into grouchy, sleepy monsters?
One's idea of fun is singing, dancing and making friends by adding One! Learn to count to 10 by adding one with the Numberblocks.
Nim and The Makery decide to dance and have a party. Nim makes a party cat picture, bakes disco light garlic bread, and creates a bubble bath costume with a crafty kid.

Hannah and the kids are inspired by a mural in a community garden by a local French artist, Hugues Sineux. They paint pots and add plants to complement the artwork and make the green space even more beautiful.
Emma and Matt can hardly hear you over the noisy cicadas! Matt makes a beehive painting and Kiya and Jemima have a noisy camping trip with a blowfly, cicada and mozzie!

Poppy is a Fijian native dog whose nose was cut off in a horrific hunting accident, Chris has brought her to Australia for major reconstructive surgery and hopefully a whole new life.

One year-old Hero has been vomiting all day and his owners are worried he’s been up to his old tricks eating rocks from their backyard. Can Lisa help the naughty Labrador pass the rock or will he be forced to have major surgery?
Mitsy may appear to be normal but there is something terribly wrong. The rescue kitten is struggling to walk. Andrew Marchevsky is left with no other option but to operate.

Emotions are running high at the clinic. Watch as Chris reunites with Poppy to search for a perfect foster home, helps a donkey facing a drastically diminished quality of life, and has his heart stolen by a homeless cat.

Join Chris at Victoria’s Kyabram Vet Clinic, where he helps a pregnant cow survive a difficult labor and saves a Maltese terrier’s unborn pups. Back in Sydney, Tim tries to assist a magnificent peregrine falcon that’s been grounded.

Harriet the Bearded Dragon is a much loved resident of the local Fauna Park. Her Keeper Hannah is concerned about a lump that has suddenly appeared on the dragon's leg. The worry is that it could be cancer.

At the Australian reptile park, Operations Manager Tim Faulkner is responding to an in-house emergency. Cameron the Cormorant has swallowed a mystery object Tim needs to remove the object urgently or Cameron may choke to death.

Help navigate a big decision as Chris works with a family to choose the perfect mini pig for a pet. Then find out if a beloved dog has a terrifying rare disease, and if Tim is up for the gargantuan task of weighing a Galapagos Tortoise.

Experience a series of scares that have Chris and the team on high alert. First, get close to a crocodile with a crooked jaw. Then watch a schnauzer suffer a deadly snake bite while a famous goldfish causes panic in the operating room. .

Ten-week-old Nala has an extremely swollen face. It is so bad that she can barely see. The little Golden Retriever needs to stay in overnight for observation, but her protective owner isn’t willing to part with her baby.
Veterinarian Chris faces a critical decision for Gizmo, a rescued Shih Tzu whose persistent ear infections threaten his adoption prospects despite months of failed treatments.

A sudden problem with Jemima’s hind leg has put an abrupt stop to her full throttle lifestyle. The shorthaired pointer has shattered her cruciate ligament, and without surgery she will never be able to walk normally again.
11 year old Tash has fallen in love with a surrendered appaloosa gelding, Charlie. Tash is worried about a huge lump growing on Charlie’s eye and she’s hoping Chris can save her much loved Charlie.
A tense night as Chris fights to save a policeman's poisoned pet, rescues a malnourished penguin that washed up onshore and operates on a young pup with a disintegrating leg.

Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12-year-old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There's also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle, and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth. Dinosaurs dominated for 150 million years, but they weren't alone.

Like animals, the lives of plants are a race to grow and breed, to make sure they leave a genetic legacy. They must race to beat their communities to the best light spots or to make the most of short seasons. And to breed some catapult offspring around the forest, some use the wind.

We think of plants as inanimate objects, but they are anything but. Plants have cunning tricks, from shedding their leaves to producing antifreeze to escape the weather. They will cover themselves in thorns and produce toxic chemicals to try and defend themselves from animals that want to eat them.

In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.
Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

Every spring in Norway, whales use a clever hunting technique called bubble feeding to catch quantities of herring. When they spot a shoal of herring, they begin to encircle the herring, periodically releasing streams of bubbles that form a curtain of air, surrounding the fish.
Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

Life evolved in the sea, in a water-bound planet, but landmasses slowly appeared and aquatic life began to explore different ways to colonize it. Plants were the first pioneers, then insects to feast on them, and then each other.

The story of the Antonov An-225, a relic of the cold war era aircraft made in the Ukraine that still flies challenging missions today. It is the biggest airplane in the world and holds the most air records for cargo lift.

An in-depth look at the complex heavy lift process of taking an old ship, cutting it in half, and stretching it - an operation called Jumboisation, increasingly common as the demand in the lucrative cruise industry for bigger ships that can haul more and more passengers.

Dustin Kott and Kevin Dunsworth build classic café bikes for high-profile athletes, including two-time Olympic gold medalist Kaillie Humphries.

The Crood family must travel through strange and stunning territory to find a new home after their cave is destroyed. Along the way the family meet a curious young nomad who changes their fate.
A young Viking with aspirations of becoming a dragon hunter befriends a young dragon, and learns more about the creatures than he ever assumed.
After discovering a secret cave filled with wild dragons and their mysterious benefactor, Hiccup and Toothless find themselves at the centre of a battle to protect the peace of Berk.

p.t: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
p.d: When the evil Grimmel launches a devious plan to wipe out all dragons, Viking leader Hiccup must unite both clans to find Caldera, a hidden world that holds the key to saving Toothless and his flying friends.

Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine whether human beings are to remain the apex predators.

Officers are on the look-out for a car linked to the theft of two motorbikes, but when they spot the vehicle parked up and it immediately races off forcing them into a chase. With stingers at the ready, it's not long before the getaway car's tyres are shredded and the suspects abandon the car and go on the run.

A&E staff treat a man injured in a hit-and-run accident, an 86-year-old with a severe ankle injury from a fall, a man with serious burns on his arms and leg and an 82-year-old whose dangerously fast heart rate suggests a stroke.
Officers raid a suspected drug den with a stubborn door, chase down a souped-up hot hatch, and deal with a rowdy late-night reveller in Nantwich town centre.
The lifeguards are alerted to a UFO sighting on Bondi's iconic shores, that is, an unidentified floating object.
Judge Judy Sheindlin tackles real-life small claims cases with her no nonsense attitude.
Judge Judy Sheindlin tackles real-life small claims cases with her no nonsense attitude.
A pawnshop owner is accused of prematurely selling a customer's jewellery; they demand payback.

When a homeless mother throws a party in an out-of-town friend's house, accusations of property damage are quick to follow; when a landlady's basement starts to smell, she realises that her ex-tenant left a stray cat behind.
Every day, millions of thousands of people arrive at airport border crossings. From citizens with undeclared food to international drug smugglers, border services officers see them all.
A woman acting suspiciously is stopped at the border and officers are shocked by what she's hiding in one of the programs most bizarre and unusual busts.
In New Zealand, the term 'Police Ten 7' means 'Police have arrived on the scene'. This unique fly-on-the-wall reality series brims with action as it follows urban cops on the beat.
A man is caught speeding at 126kmph in an 80 zone, in an unregistered car with the wrong number plates. But his biggest worry is getting the woman he's out with home before her boyfriend finds out.
A look at how Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team deals with trauma incidents.
The Interceptors come under attack from a gang of violent, armed robbers, and boys in 'Big Blue Van' respond to reports of bottles raining down on streets.
A first-time offender regrets his decisions. Nothing adds up when a driver tells police that he's the victim of a crime. A deputy encourages a troubled young woman to turn her life around.

A wealthy businessman Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins.

Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.
Two down-on-their-luck performers form a Neil Diamond tribute band, proving it's never too late to find love and follow your dreams.

Anora, a sex worker from Brooklyn, gets her chance at a Cinderella story when she meets and marries the son of an oligarch. Once the news reaches Russia, her fairytale is threatened as the parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.
In search of a lost pleasure, Emmanuelle flies alone to Hong Kong and meets a man who constantly eludes her.

Lawman Frank Bennett uncovers a massive smuggling operation after a deadly confrontation. Cut off from cell service and without his truck, he's forced to take on a dangerous gang led by a deranged ex-military commander.
Thrown together under tragic circumstances, three generations of women from the same family are forced to learn to live together on a small rural chicken farm in New Jersey.
As college tests their relationship, a freshman quarterback and a promising dancer navigate love and distance while searching for who they're meant to be.

As the world's top assassins fight to the death in a ruthless underground tournament, a rogue crew has its own deadly agenda: survive the carnage, outplay the killers, and take down the mastermind behind it all.

Marvin is a Milwaukee realtor who receives a crimson envelope from a former partner-in-crime whom he left for dead. He now finds himself thrust back into a world of ruthless hit men and double-crosses that turn his open houses into deadly war zones.
Explores Nick Cave's creative process and influence through reflections from collaborators and artists, delving into the shadowy, mythic stories and inspirations that define his music.
A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death.

Bad dreams haunt 15-year-old Gwen as she receives calls from the black phone and sees disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp. With help from her brother, she must now confront a killer who's grown even more powerful in death.

Rickey, an energetic and free-spirited young man with a Peter Pan complex, convinces his long-time friend Glenn to hit pause on his blissful domestic life and embark on an impromptu road trip across California.

After the death of his wife, Sam Baldwin moves to Seattle with his son, Jonah. When Jonah calls in to a talk-radio program to find a new wife for his father, Sam grudgingly gets on the line to discuss his feelings. Annie Reed, a reporter in Baltimore, hears Sam speak and falls for him, even though she is engaged. Unsure where it will lead, she writes Sam a letter asking him to meet her at the Empire State Building on Valentine's Day.
A rude, drug-abusing educator vies with a perky colleague for the attentions of a rich and handsome substitute teacher.

p.t: Matchmaker Mysteries: The Art of the Kill
p.d: Angie Dove, her father and Detective Carter investigate murder, theft, blackmail and fraud at the museum.
Eight very different couples and their love lives intertwine during a hectic month before Christmas in London.
A year in the life of a neurotic thirty-something who resolves to take control of her life once and for all.

Lt. Callie Jackson returns home after a military tour to find her late grandfather's barbecue joint is struggling, but she has a run-in with a TV director who teaches her that sometimes it's best to look forward instead of looking back.
The Crawley family goes on a grand journey to the South of France to uncover the mystery of the dowager countess's newly inherited villa.
After a man pours out his love for his late wife on radio, a listener inexplicably decides that he is her destiny and treks across the USA to meet him.
Wealthy tycoon Zsa-zsa Korda names his nun daughter sole heir. As he starts a new venture, they face threats from scheming rivals, terrorists, and assassins.
An extraterrestrial finds a friend in 10-year-old Elliot, while members of a task force work day and night to track down the whereabouts of Earth's first visitor from outer space.
The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.
Family Guy creator Seth MacFarlane brings his brazen humour to the screen when a grown man must deal with the loved teddy bear that came to life from a childhood wish and has refused to leave since.
When he is ruled to be property and not a person, a foul-mouthed teddy bear seeks the aid of a legendary civil rights attorney to gain the justice he deserves.
After falling out of a shopping cart, our hero sausage and his new friends embark on a perilous journey through the supermarket to discover the truth about their existence!
Hobbs and Shaw, the trash-talking sworn enemies must team up to take down a cyber-genetically enhanced anarchist with a bio weapon that threatens the fate of humanity.
Over one day across the streets of LA, three lives will change forever. Desperate brothers hijack an ambulance after their heist goes awry, spiralling into the most insane escape.
The orphanage where Jake and Elwood were raised will be sold unless the tax on the property is paid within days. The brothers decide to raise the money by putting their band back together.
In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who for decades has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: A Day In Munich
p.d: S4 E9The crew visits Germany, where they meet up with Louie Vito and their tour guide Klaus. Klaus takes the crew on a bus tour of the city. During the tour they play the game UP! and upset the tour guide and the others on the bus. After the tour, Danny lets Eero cut his hair in the local snowboard shop. Dingo and Louie both buy lederhosen and go surfing in a local river.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Smells Like Gypsy
p.d: S4 E10While Danny is showing the Grenade line at the Bright Trade Show in Berlin, Dingo decides to go to Poland. Danny gives the crew a Gypsy List of objectives to complete to win cash. They kidnap a Japanese photographer Rip Zinger so he can give them directions to the Berlin Wall. They tag the Wall and afterward join a parade.

p.t: The Moto: Inside the Outdoors: Welcome to the Big Time
p.d: S2 E4Dungey is looking strong mid-moto season and all of the 450cc riders are strategizing on how to beat #5.

p.t: The Moto: Inside the Outdoors: Keep Fighting
p.d: S2 E5With the championship title near Dungey's grasp, Brett Metcalfe and Andrew Short gear up to battle for second place overall in the 450cc Outdoor Series.
S2 E6Jeff King and crew visit Florida's KONA skatepark, where they convert a skate shop into a skate spot and get some FMX action going on the park's concrete curves.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Get Back Up Again
p.d: S1 E3Just Getting Started is an all-access pass to the Norco Race Division. New team. New look. New series. Riders: Greg Minnaar, Gracey Hemstreet, Lucas Cruz, Kirk McDowall.
Field Productions' Side By Side brings massive tricks in the terrain parks, intense big mountain skiing on the most scenic locations in Norway.

S1 E3Luca Elder is the host for this episode, where San Clemente native surfer, Pat Gudauskas, talks about his hometown rich surfing culture, shares some his family archival images, reflects on the WQS struggles and his World Tour experience, and then proceeds to breakdown a quiver of his boards, including a retro-style model that helps him extend his turns.
S1 E4Pro surfer Luca Elder breaks down the surfboard quiver of prodigious Australian wave wizard Reef Heazlewood.

S1 E2There's an image that springs to mind when you think of Mozambique: the silhouette of an elephant. But what happens when a country's emblem comes into conflict with its people? João Kopke goes in search of waves on the East African coast to find out who is mitigating these encounters.

S1 E3Brendon Gibbens' surfing is all about speed and above-the-lip flight, from J-Bay walls to SoCal beachbreaks. In this Quivers episode he breaks down a four-board arsenal shaped by Panda Surfboards and others, plus why first impressions matter and boards need time to break in.
S2 E1Shayne and Shannon Mcintyre surf and explore Nicaragua and discover the beauty and tragedy of a nation trying to rebuild itself from its turbulent past and open its doors to the world.
S1 E5Tony's attitude improves when he joins instruction; Miles and Tyler enjoy camp life to the fullest.
S1 E6Emotions run high during the final days of camp, as Tony, Miles and Tyler reach their goals.

S3 E1Jeff King and the crew crash land in an aviation warehouse. The world's largest airplane graveyard has thousands of burned out airplanes and debris waiting to be rearranged and shredded. The Built To Shred crew along with the Plan B team and S&M bike crew build and shred.

While investigating one of the bloodiest battlefields in history, TAPS has a close encounter with Americas past

Josh Gates from Destination Truth joins the TAPS team as they embark on their next ghost hunting adventure - this time, in the haunted Essex County Jail. Are there souls still imprisoned in jail? Join the Ghost Hunters as they navigate through a dangerous labyrinth of rusty cells, deserted hallways and eerie underground tunnels to find the answer.

TAPS is joined by Dave Tango's father, Bruce Tango, to help the team investigate the Union County Courthouse in Elizabeth, New Jersey. Later, on the second investigation, TAPS investigates a 19th-century home in Hopkinton, New Hampshire.

The Church of St. Andrews in Staten Island NY is known as the friendliest church in the valley, yet recent paranormal activity has church staff spooked - are ghostly parishioners haunting the grounds? Then the Ghost Hunters head to the Windy City, where angry spirits have allegedly taken control of a local community center in South Chicago.

Musical legend Meat Loaf joins the team for an exciting investigation of Syfy's Great American Ghost Hunt winner Danielle Parody's estate. The private island has been in Danielle's family for over 50 years and since that time many have made claims about paranormal encounters in and around the property.
TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship.
TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site.

The team returns to Chicago to investigate the historic Congress Theater. Since it was established in 1925, infamous acts like Prince and Billy Idol have graced the stage. Yet recently, the most popular shows appear to be the ones that go on behind the scenes when the paranormals come out to play.

TAPS heads to Colorado to investigate the manor where the walls are bleeding. Briarhurst Manor was originally built in 1888 and is 14,000 square feet of pure eeriness. This swank (and spooky) property was a finalist in Syfy's Great American Ghost Hunt contest. America voted and thinks the place is haunted, so the team heads in to investigate.

TAPS investigates the Buffalo Bill museum with guest hunter Eddie McClintock from the hit Syfy series Warehouse 13. According to various workers, the museum is filled with unexplained activity that appears paranormal; so the Ghost Hunters head in to investigate.

The team travels to Fitzwilliam, New Hampshire to investigate the Amos J. Blake House Museum. Then they head to the Arbona Building in Pensacola, Florida where books fall off shelves perfectly stacked.
TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports.
TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences.

TAPS heads to Willow Grove, Pennsylvania to investigate an 18th-century farmhouse, where it has been claimed to be inhabited by spirits that allegedly play with the lights and cast large, dark shadows. Later, on the second investigation of the episode, TAPS heads to Hartford, Connecticut to the Old State House. Where it has been claimed to have disembodied voices and phantom footfalls.

TAPS hits the road for the season's final destination to investigate the Hindenburg crash site in New Jersey. Many believe spirits of those who lost their lives in the disaster continue to haunt the Lakehurst Naval Air Station today.

p.t: Secret Weapons Of World War II
p.d: Exploring weapons ranging from the bouncing bomb and Tall Boy to nature-inspired ones, like homing pigeons and incendiary-armed bats.
An elite detachment of SAS Special Forces are sent to lead an attack, in charge is Roy Farran - a veteran who craves action and who disobeys orders to join his men on the raid.

After the German's defeat in WWI the Allies decreed that the Luftwaffe would never again be a threat. Secretly through the '20s and '30s, Germany began to rebuild her military capabilities and the Luftwaffe.
As the beach of the Severn River erodes, it reveals astonishing evidence of some of this country's earliest inhabitants. But can evidence be recovered before it's destroyed by the fierce tide?
Abandoned Americana seeks to tell the hidden history of the United States through its forgotten ruins and those who know their stories.
Scientists in Kamienna Gora work to keep the Luftwaffe flying but are they also building Hitler's next revenge weapon?
A vast network of Nazi bunkers buried in the Hague tells the story of the greatest battle of WWII that never was.
Stories of human abduction by otherworldly entities have been told for thousands of years; often those abducted return to Earth with new knowledge or instructions for mankind.

Col. Jack O'Neill and his new SG recruits have become the targets of a secret hostile takeover. Now it's up to a wounded O'Neill and his neophyte troop to save the command center from a possible alien invasion! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

When Teal'c is trapped in the Stargate network, SG-1 is given 48 hours to get him back by an impatient superior officer with his own agenda, all of which forces the team to ask an unlikely source for help completing their dangerous mission.

A truce has been declared among the Goa'uld, so that the warlords can attend a summit on the future of universe domination. Since Jackson speaks fluent Goa'uld, he is sent to the summit disguised as an aide. But his real mission is to poison the delegates! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.
Enslaved by the Goa'uld, Dr Jackson attempts to destroy the System Lords, and SG-1 faces an attack on the Tok'ra homeworld.

As an asteroid hurtles toward Earth, SG-1 uses an abandoned Goa'uld ship as a launch pad for a mega-bomb designed to destroy the rock before impact. But when SGC loses the ship's signal, it's feared that the team is dead and that Earth is in peril.

The Goa'uld K'tano (guest star Rick Worthy), former First Prime of the late Imhotep, is now the leader of a powerful Jaffa rebellion. SG-1 visits K'tano's stronghold with the aim of securing an alliance. But O'Neill and the team soon learn that this strategic partnership may well come at a heavy price. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

A dormant android is discovered on a barren planet and transported back to Earth for study. At the SGC, it is placed in a secure environment and activated. The android, a female robot named Reese, demonstrates a childlike curiosity for her environment world and an instant affection for Daniel. As SG-1 questions her in an attempt to find out what happened to her world, the team discovers this seemingly innocent being may hold a menacing secret.

Col. O'Neill must enlist the aid of a couple of convicted felons in a bid to save a planet from the Goa'uld. With an attack looming and the planet's automated defense systems seemingly offline, an entire world's salvation rests in the hands of SG-1 and two former NID operatives. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.
Daniel Jackson returns from an off-world diplomatic mission, stricken with radiation poisoning and accused of sabotage by the host government.
SG-1 mounts a rescue mission to save Heimdall, an Asgard scientist, and secure an underground laboratory before they fall into the hands of Anubis.
Jonas is eager to finish what Dr. Jackson started. The Stargate malfunctions, and Carter informs O'Neill that it could destroy all life on Earth.
With the Stargate transformed into a timebomb, Earth's only hope lies in a gambit by SG-1 that could result in the loss of the portal forever.
Trapped on a Goa'uld mothership at the bottom of the ocean by Anubis, the SG1 team discover the craft is on self-destruct and that they only have 17 minutes to get out.

There are three weeks left in the Bluefin tuna fishing season as the fleet battles for final paychecks and the title of Gloucester's top earning fishing boat. Pinwheel is in the lead for the first time in six weeks and determined to hold that lead until the last day of the season. Last year's worst performing boat, Fish Hawk, is breathing down Pinwheel's neck in second position. Four-time champion FV-Tuna.Com plays catch up, trailing in third position and not happy about it. While Hot Tuna continues their successful season coming of a two fish catch last week but they haven't been in the top spot in nine weeks. Also looking to move up the ladder of profit and glory is Wicked Pissah who has been in the lead position only once this season. While Hard Merchandise tries desperately to make any kind of profit for the family. Who will bring in the fish and who could crack under the pressure?

The FV-Tuna.com has been the top-earning boat in the fleet for the past two years. Dave Carraro is confident his team can finish out the season strong, but the rest of the fleet is in hot pursuit. Tyler McLaughlin knows that he needs to turn every single hookup into a catch in order to take the lead away from Carraro. And Brad Krasowski is just one big catch away.

With only one week left in bluefin season, the fleet competes for final paychecks and the championship. Longtime champion FV-Tuna.com and rival boat Pinwheel are forced off the water by illness and injury, and having the two top contenders out of the race is a game-changer for the fleet, pushing everyone to go for broke to score an upset and become Gloucester’s top-earning boat.

With less than 4 days left in the North Atlantic Bluefin Tuna season, the fleet race to claim the title of Gloucester's top earning bluefin boat. But with two top contenders, last season's champion Captain Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com and previous top-earner Captain Tyler McLaughlin on the Pinwheel, potentially sidelined, the field is wide open and it will all come down to the last fish.

It's opening day of the bluefin tuna season; after a mediocre performance in the Outer Banks, Capt. Dave Marciano is ready for his first season aboard his new boat, the Falcon; Capt. Tyler McLaughlin copes with the unexpected loss of his mate.
It's week two of the bluefin tuna fishing season and the sibling crew on the Pinwheel continue to fish in honour of their fallen mate.

When a familiar face returns to Gloucester to compete for the title of top bluefin fisherman, the fleet isn't very welcoming. And for one fisherman, the ocean just isn't big enough for the both of them.

The captains each have their own fishing ideologies, strategies and even superstitions, but they have to rely on a whole lot of luck to try to turn their fortunes around after a sudden bout of bad luck strikes the fleet.

Capts. Dave Marciano and TJ Ott struggle near the bottom of the leader board; Capt. Dave Marciano's nephew, Jay, brings a shot of energy to the Falcon; Capt. Tyler McLaughlin strives to pull ahead; all three captains turn to family members for help.

The captains are challenged when a large group of boats shows up for the weekend. Hot Tuna must decide whether to risk leaving a familiar bluefin hot spot in order to climb the leaderboard. Meanwhile, FV-Tuna.com’s and Pinwheel’s determination to be No. 1 in a tight race to the top forces the fleet to prove they can steer in the right direction to catch bluefin and stand out from the crowd.

Its almost the mid-point of blue fin tuna fishing season so the clock is ticking. Longtime rivals F/V-Tuna.Com and Pinwheel continue battling for the top spot in the fleet. But, a new strategy of boat alliances may threaten their dominance. Hot Tuna ] and Falcon work together and Paul Hebert gets his mojo back, but, trust is on the line for every boat along with big paydays and the elusive title of champion.

Stormy seas are on the horizon and when Mother Nature decides to flip her switch, the fleet must decide whether to stay and gamble or give up the hunt. Pinwheel and Dot Com have been fighting each other for the top spot on the leaderboard all season long, but with rough weather ahead, fish are biting and the title is up for grabs. Who wants it most?
As the season reaches a turning point, a change in the quota forces boats to push their limits, creating tension on the water.

The smaller quota of one bluefin tuna per day has changed the dynamic of the fleet, making it difficult to take or maintain a lead. It is imperative captains bring in a catch every single day. It also makes fishing far offshore a gamble because of the travel time and extra fuel costs. But one captain, desperate to salvage his season, decides to take his chances on a trip to Georges Bank.

Captain Tyler McLaughlin feels the pressure to stay ahead of his rival Captain Dave Carraro, but a new boat of friendly faces joins the fleet. The Whistler was formerly the original Pinwheel, and Captain Kevin Granfield is an old friend of McLaughlin’s. The two captains vow to help each other find fish and give McLaughlin the edge he needs to take the lead. Mechanical troubles plague the Falcon.
